declarations.description: A viewport that pans and zooms whatever is slotted in it: an image, an SVG diagram, a floor plan, a board. The content is laid out at its natural size and moved with one transform; `fit` chooses the first view (`contain` shows all of it), `min-zoom` / `max-zoom` bound the zoom, and `bounds="content"` keeps the content in view while `bounds="none"` makes a free canvas. A drag pans (not when it starts on a link, button, form control or `[data-pan-zoom="ignore"]`; Space + drag and a middle-button drag always pan), Ctrl/⌘ + wheel and a pinch zoom to the pointer, a double-click zooms in one step, and a released drag glides. `gestures` sets what the plain wheel and one finger do: `cooperative` (the default) leaves them to the page and shows a hint, `pan` pans as in Figma, `zoom` zooms as in a map, `none` leaves only the buttons, the keys and the methods. The viewport is one tab stop: the arrows pan (Shift for a quarter of the view), `+` / `-` zoom, `0` fits and `1` goes to 100%; `no-keyboard` hands the keys to a component that draws its own content. Focus moving to content out of view pans it into view. `controls` draws a toolbar (zoom out, the zoom percent, zoom in, fit) and `minimap` an overview that shows while the content overflows: the `minimap` slot, else a copy of a single slotted ``, `

members.name: minZoom
members.description: Least zoom: a number, or `fit` to stop zooming out at the fitted view (for image previews).

members.name: maxZoom
members.description: Greatest zoom (1 = 100%).

members.name: zoomStep
members.description: The factor of one button press or key press.

members.name: fitMode
members.description:
The first view, and the view `reset()` and the `0` key go back to: `contain` shows the whole content, `cover` fills
the box, `width` fits the width and starts at the top, `none` starts at 100% in the centre. A fitted view never
zooms past 100%.

members.name: bounds
members.description: `content` keeps the content in view (content smaller than the box stays centred); `none` is a free canvas.

members.name: gestures
members.description:
What the wheel and one finger do. `cooperative`: they scroll the page, and Ctrl/⌘ + wheel, a pinch, two fingers
or a mouse drag move the view. `pan`: the wheel pans and Ctrl/⌘ + wheel zooms. `zoom`: the wheel zooms to the
pointer. `none`: only the buttons, the keys and the methods move the view.

members.name: controls
members.description: Draws the toolbar: zoom out, the zoom percent, zoom in and fit.

members.name: minimap
members.description: Draws the minimap, which shows while the content overflows.

members.name: noInertia
members.description: A released drag stops at once instead of gliding.

members.name: noDoubleClickZoom
members.description: A double-click (or double tap) no longer zooms in.

members.name: noKeyboard
members.description: The viewport is not a tab stop and has no role; the component around it handles the keys.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the viewport.

members.name: zoom
members.description: The current zoom (1 = 100%). Setting it zooms around the centre, without an event.

members.name: view
members.description:
The view: `{ x, y, zoom }`, where `x` and `y` are the content point at the top-left corner. Setting it (or the
`view` attribute, as JSON) moves the view without an event, so a saved view comes back with no jump, even from a
server render.

members.name: initial
members.description: Where the first view comes from: the fit, the `view` attribute, or the `zoom` attribute (centred).

members.name: measured
members.description: Sizes known: false on the server and until the first measurement.

members.name: touched
members.description: The view was moved since the last fit, so a resize keeps it rather than fitting again.

type.text: { x: number; y: number; time: number } | null

members.name: zoomIn
members.description: Zooms in one `zoom-step`, around the centre.

members.name: zoomOut
members.description: Zooms out one `zoom-step`, around the centre.

members.name: zoomTo
members.description: Zooms to `zoom` (held to `min-zoom` / `max-zoom`) around `origin`, the centre by default; animated by default.

members.name: fit
members.description: Fits the content: `mode` is `contain`, `cover`, `width` or `none` (the `fit` attribute by default).

members.name: reset
members.description: Goes back to the first view, the `fit` attribute's.

members.name: panBy
members.description: Pans by `dx`, `dy` CSS pixels: positive values show content further right and down. Not animated by default.

members.name: centerOn
members.description: Centres content point `point` (in the content's own pixels), at `options.zoom` when given; animated by default.

members.name: zoomToElement
members.description:
Frames a part of the content: an element of it, or a rectangle in content pixels. It is fitted with `padding`
round it, up to `maxZoom`; animated by default.

members.name: reveal
members.description:
Pans the least distance that brings an element of the content, or a rectangle in content pixels, into view with
`padding` round it, without zooming; animated by default.

members.name: toContentPoint
members.description: The content point under a pointer position (`clientX`, `clientY`), for dropping things on a board.

members.name: readTheme
members.description: Reads what the theme sets in CSS: the fit padding and the minimap's size, resolved by the browser.

members.name: duration
members.description: Duration of animated moves in milliseconds, from `--c2-pan-zoom--transition-duration`.

members.name: defer
members.description: Runs `call` once the first measurement is made; true when it had to wait.

members.name: base
members.description: The view an incremental move starts from: the end of the running animation, else the current view.

members.name: setView
members.description: Sets the view, and reports it once per frame. `raw` skips the limits (an animation's steps are already held).

members.name: maybeSettle
members.description: Fires `view-settle` once nothing moves the view any more.

members.name: moveTo
members.description: Moves to `target`, eased unless `animate` is false or the user prefers reduced motion.

members.name: rectOf
members.description: An element's box in content pixels (from the view the DOM shows), or a rectangle passed through.

members.name: foldScroll
members.description: A scroll the browser made to show a focused element becomes part of the view.

members.name: handleGestureStart
members.description: Safari's trackpad pinch, which it reports as gesture events rather than Ctrl + wheel.

members.name: handleFocusIn
members.description: Focus moving to an element of the content that is out of view pans it into view.

members.name: syncArt
members.description: Chooses what the minimap draws: its slot, a copy of a single image, SVG or canvas, else a rectangle.

members.name: drawSvgArt
members.description: Copies the slotted SVG, without anything that could run or define elements.

members.name: drawCanvasArt
members.description: Copies the slotted canvas; done again each time the view settles.

events.name: view-settle
events.description: The same detail, once when a move and its glide end. Does not bubble.

`{ x, y, zoom, reason }` once per frame while the view moves. `x` and `y` are the content point at the top-left corner; `reason` is `gesture`, `wheel`, `keyboard`, `controls`, `fit`, `resize` or `api`. Not fired when `view` or `zoom` is set. Does not bubble.
